class.name: StrideWarpingModifier3D
class.brief_description: Scales the stride of a walk or run animation so feet do not slide when the playback speed is clamped.
class.description: A [SkeletonModifier3D] similar to Unreal Engine's "Stride Warping". It scales the horizontal (skeleton-space XZ) offsets of the feet from the pelvis by [member stride_scale] and re-solves each leg with analytic two-bone IK. [member stride_scale] is usually [code]actual_speed / animation_speed[/code]; see [method set_speeds]. The skeleton Y axis is expected to point up in the skeleton's own space.

method.name: add_leg
method.description: Adds a leg and returns its index.

method.name: compute_stride_scale
method.description: Returns [code]actual_speed / animation_speed[/code] clamped to the given range, or [code]1.0[/code] if [param animation_speed] is zero.

method.name: set_speeds
method.description: Sets [member stride_scale] from the actual movement speed and the speed the animation was authored for, clamped by [member min_stride_scale] and [member max_stride_scale].

method.name: warp_foot_position
method.description: Scales the XZ offset of [param foot] from [param pelvis] by [param scale] and keeps the foot height.

members.member: The number of legs. Each leg has [code]legs/<index>/thigh_bone[/code], [code]calf_bone[/code] and [code]foot_bone[/code].
The upper bound used by [method set_speeds].
The lower bound used by [method set_speeds].
The pelvis bone feet offsets are measured from. Required.
The factor applied to the horizontal foot offsets from the pelvis. [code]1.0[/code] leaves the animation unchanged.
